findings.reason: The artifact faithfully preserves the requested latency-reduction study, unchanged retrieval quality and evidence-grounded report. It invents no method, numeric target or hardware.
All material source content is represented: the baseline, both relevant metrics, the quality constraint, requested report, unchosen study parameters and absence of empirical measurements.

The interpretation, scope, constraints and targets consistently concern the same document retrieval baseline and require latency reduction while preserving retrieval quality. No mandatory constraints conflict.

The artifact defines an actionable study purpose and concrete report deliverable with explicit quality and evidence requirements. Unchosen implementation parameters do not prevent beginning the study.

limitations: No empirical measurements are supplied; acceptance does not establish achievable latency reduction or scientific success.
The method, numeric improvement threshold and hardware remain unchosen.
